title: Nonempty convex sets are connected
statement: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional real vector space [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] with its usual finite-dimensional topology. A subset $C\subseteq E$ is convex if $(1-t)u+tv\in C$ for every $u,v\in C$ and every $t\in[0,1]$. Every nonempty convex subset $C$ is connected: it cannot be written as the union of two disjoint nonempty subsets both open in the subspace topology of $C$.
